title: FBI-UAP-D011, D/FBI Correspondence Referral, 1949
what_is_it: Correspondence between FBI Director J. Edgar Hoover and a civilian witness, with a referral letter to the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC), regarding a reported UAP sighting.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text was extractable from this scanned image; all facts derive from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov, not from direct reading of the document.
Single civilian witness account with no corroborating observations noted.
The witness's own hypothesis (military/scientific experiment) is speculative and unconfirmed.
The nature of the 'beams of light' and 'explosion' is uncharacterised — no instrumented measurement was described.
